# data.docker_compose_volumes

<!-- Code generated by tools/genskill from the provider schema. DO NOT EDIT. -->

Kind: data-source. Back to [SKILL.md](../SKILL.md).

Lists the volumes of a compose project, like `docker compose volumes`, by the `com.docker.compose.project` label.
